A modern car runs more software than a

Medical devices now run AI on-device — imaging, 
monitoring, surgical guidance, all real-time.
➢
Industrial machines decide and act in milliseconds

➢
AI is moving from software assistance into real-

➢

manufacturing.
➢

➢
AI is moving from pilots to production — but 
regulated industries need certifiable outputs, not 
just accurate ones.
➢
The skills gap is real — 75% of enterprises want 
service partners to build their priority AI use cases 
(BCG 2026).
➢
IT-first competitors are entering engineering — 
but lack embedded depth, safety certification, 
and V-model delivery history.
